high_level_description: The image is a motivational quote attributed to Richard Feynman, displayed on a clean, minimalist background. The quote reads: "You have no responsibility to live up to what other people think you ought to accomplish. I have no responsibility to be like they expect me to be. It's their mistake, not my failing." The text is presented in a clear, readable font with the first two sentences in black and the third sentence highlighted in orange for emphasis. Below the quote, the name "Richard Feynman" is written in white text on a dark rectangular background.
